body:
Galactic Engineering Knowledge Compiler. Converts shared scientific knowledge into locally executable designs adapted to each settlement's available resources and capabilities.

This database covers the technology as item 216 entry 70 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (B)" catalog, section "Stellar and Interstellar Expansion". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: theoretically plausible. Knowledge-to-design is real; galactic adaptation is speculative.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.
